claims.head: Quality over quantity for Montréal
claims.body: Washington has struggled to keep shots to the perimeter (28th of 32), and Montréal makes its shots count: one expected goal for every 14.5 unblocked shots, 2nd in the league.

claims.head: Different shooting spots
claims.body: Washington ranks 5th of 32 for point-shot reliance, toward the point-heavy end; Montréal ranks 24th, toward the down low end.
